Maps to MITRE ATT&CK T1190 and T1027. Keys off WAF logs (AWS WAF, Azure WAF, Cloudflare, OWASP CRS / ModSecurity / Coraza, F5 ASM), CDN and reverse-proxy access logs, and backend error logs. Gives a normalization-first detection approach, a WAF-miss and desync hunt, and rule-tuning and protocol-strictness hardening. Use when hardening or tuning a WAF, closing encoding and double-encoding evasion gaps, defending against request-smuggling desync, raising OWASP CRS paranoia level, triaging requests that pass the WAF but error at the backend, or hunting for signature-evasion against a public web app.

skills.name: detect-deauth
skills.description: Detection and response methodology for 802.11 deauthentication and disassociation flooding, a wireless denial-of-service that spoofs management frames to knock clients off an AP and often precedes an evil twin or handshake capture (MITRE ATT&CK T1498, T1498.001; enabling T1557). Signals come from wireless IDS/IPS and controller telemetry: Kismet DEAUTHFLOOD / BCASTDISCON alerts, Cisco Catalyst 9800 aWIPS, Aruba/HPE WIP, Meraki Air Marshal, and raw 802.11 captures. The skill gives the frame-level signal, log sources to watch, a hunt over reason codes and source rate, and 802.11w Protected Management Frames hardening. Use when investigating repeated Wi-Fi client drops, triaging a wireless IDS deauth or disassoc alert, hunting for an evil-twin precursor, writing wireless DoS detections, or hardening WLANs with 802.11w / WPA3 PMF.

skills.name: detect-rogue-ap
skills.description: Detection and response methodology for rogue and evil-twin wireless access points, where an attacker stands up an unauthorized AP impersonating a trusted SSID (or plants one on the wired LAN) to lure clients, harvest credentials, and run an adversary-in-the-middle (MITRE ATT&CK T1557.004, T1200; enabling T1557). The skill gives the SSID/BSSID allowlist signal, a hunt that diffs seen BSSIDs against an authorized-AP inventory, and 802.1X certificate validation and WIDS hardening. Use when investigating an unexpected AP broadcasting a corporate SSID, triaging a rogue-AP or Air Marshal SSID-spoof alert, hunting for an evil twin or a rogue AP on the wire, or writing rogue-AP detections.

skills.name: detect-wifi-recon
skills.description: Detection and response methodology for 802.11 wireless reconnaissance: wardriving and rogue scanners, hidden-SSID discovery through directed probing, and probe-request flooding used to enumerate clients and their preferred network lists (MITRE ATT&CK T1595, T1040; related T1590). skills.description: GATT access control and pairing hardening for Bluetooth Low Energy devices that treat the radio link as the trust boundary: privileged GATT characteristics left open without authentication or encryption, Just Works pairing with no MITM protection, and LE Legacy Pairing with a recoverable key (MITRE ATT&CK T1557, T1040, T1011.001).
